bullets.title: Flippable Audio Magic
bullets.text: Rotate the 20W (2 x 10W) Dolby Audio speakers 90° side to side or 200° up and down for sound that follows your vibe, perfect for any setup or scene. Measuring 183 x 204 x 228 mm and weighing 7.3 lb, it's designed for flexible placement around your home.

bullets.title: True Brightness, Real Clarity
bullets.text: Enjoy lifelike details with TÜV‑certified 380 ANSI lumens and 1080p Full HD resolution that make every movie night pop.

bullets.title: Designed for Consistent Viewing
bullets.text: All‑glass lenses and fully sealed optical engine resist dust and wear, keeping every frame crisp and clear even after hours of play.

bullets.title: Smart Instant Setup (IEA 3.0)
bullets.text: Just plug in and go. Autofocus, auto keystone correction, obstacle avoidance, and screen fit instantly deliver a perfect view every time.

bullets.title: Google TV, Stream It All
bullets.text: Access Netflix, YouTube, Prime Video, and more right from the projector — no extra devices needed, just endless entertainment anywhere. Google account and internet connection required for initial setup and Google TV access.

bullets.title: From Anker
bullets.text: Trusted by 80 Million+ Users Worldwide Engineered by Anker, the world's #1 charging brand, Nebula products are designed to deliver reliable performance across a range of home and outdoor viewing scenarios.

bullets.title: Note
bullets.text: Update Firmware for Optimized Experience.For the best out-of-the-box experience, please update to the latest Android 14 system software before your first use. This essential update includes key system optimizations and enhanced streaming app compatibility to deliver a more stable, consistent performance.

bullets.title: Note
bullets.text: The projector does not include a built-in battery. Anker SOLIX C300 Portable Power Station is recommended and can power the P1i for approximately 3.5 — 3.7 hours (with all features in use), making it suitable for backyard, outdoor, or camping use.

bullets.text: Efficiently filters dander, mold, and other common household allergens, promoting healthier indoor air quality.
